enGuide: This route's guide begins via the Gekan 'Ooka Report' (大岡レポート) shortcut, reached by choosing New Game from a fresh Gekan (下巻) start, mirroring the approach already used in route_yami_no_ou.json and route_kyuumei.json. The companion Joukan guide (route_joukan.json) spends its own Continue on the 瑠璃亜編 branch and separately walks through Joukan's own End17「灯子編」as a badEndPath detour there, but per this task's scope that Joukan-side content is out of scope here — this guide covers only the Gekan-side 灯子編 branch, reached independently via the Ooka Report. xneo.jp's Gekan page documents the Ooka Report mechanic only in service of reaching 瑠璃亜編 (its own Ending 20 and Ending 27 rows both open with an explicit ＜大岡レポート＞ choice sequence); it does not document any path to 灯子編 through the Ooka Report, so jpGuide1 is empty for this step group specifically.

enGuide: +10 BLOOD. This is the final Ooka Report branch that places the player at the start of the 灯子編 (Touko) route in Gekan, starting BLOOD level 10.

Editorial save at the start of the 下巻 灯子編 content, before the first B.S.S. opportunity. It is not gameplay-source text, so jpGuide2 correctly uses the omission placeholder. Starting BLOOD level here is 10.

Ending 6 detour — continue straight.

enGuide: Blood Search System — tap here to raise BLOOD level. This is the one B.S.S. xneo.jp's own Ending 9 row for 灯子編 begins with this exact trigger.

enGuide: Blood Search System — tap here to raise BLOOD level. Per xneo.jp's category header (新宿・歌舞伎町（闇の王編・究明編・灯子編）) this trigger and the next three (そうだね……, 正夫の手を掴まない, 正夫を追いかける) are shared across all three named routes, including 灯子編; xneo.jp's own Ending 9 row for 灯子編 goes on to name the latter two of these explicitly. This exact trigger is already documented for 闇の王編 in route_yami_no_ou.json using the identical simpleJp/jpGuide1 text.

This differs from the other three named routes, each of which documents its own distinct maze-navigation sequence through this same underground base (e.g. 右だ for 闇の王編's own endings in route_yami_no_ou.json, or 左だ→ディスクを取る→右だ→左だ for 究明編's Ending 26 in route_kyuumei.json) before reaching a comparable point.
